source: Generated (1-based row index in raw CSV)
description: Unique 1-based transaction index assigned by position in original CSV before any sorting; stable key for joining features, labels, and split assignments
Transaction date and time at 1-minute resolution (YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM); excluded from model inputs to prevent calendar-based leakage
Sending bank identifier; stored as string to preserve leading zeros; excluded from model inputs
Sending account identifier; unique only within sender_bank (composite key is bank_id + account_id); excluded from model inputs
Receiving bank identifier; stored as string to preserve leading zeros; excluded from model inputs
Receiving account identifier; unique only within receiver_bank (composite key is bank_id + account_id); excluded from model inputs
Amount received by beneficiary account; excluded from model inputs to prevent leakage from implicit exchange rates
Currency in which the beneficiary received payment; excluded from model inputs (payment_currency is used instead)
Raw amount paid by sender; transformed to log_amount_paid for model input; raw value excluded from model inputs
Natural logarithm of (1 + amount_paid); compresses scale of transaction amounts without cross-currency addition
Currency paid by sender; kept alongside amount; never aggregated across currencies
Payment rail / instrument used for the transaction
allowed_values_or_range: ACH, Cheque, Wire, Credit Card, Cash, etc.
